content: 'Ikwai mɨ'itiya meta mɨka'itiya
»Yawé Kakaɨyari xeme xekaniniwemamatɨni. Yuwaiyari xepɨkatixitekeni meta yumu'utsie xepɨkayukametseriyani, xewitɨ mumɨ hetsiemieme,
xeme karikɨ teɨteri xemɨpatsie xekanihɨkɨtɨni Yawé xekakaɨyari hetsiemieme. Mɨkɨ kanixe'anayexeiya yunaime hipame kwiepa memɨtama watsata, xeme yemekɨ hetsɨana miemete xemɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ.
»Tixaɨtɨmexi yeutari xepɨkatewakwaka memɨtexani'eriwa.
'Ikɨ xeikɨa xemɨtewakwaka kaniyɨwemɨkɨ: 'atuuru kwietsaname, muxa, kapɨra,
muxa tuuru hepaɨ mɨ'ane, yeutanaka maxa hepaɨ mɨ'ane, maxa, kapɨra yeutanaka.
Xekaniyɨwaweni xemɨwakwaka yeutari memɨte'iyawa wakarutsa manutahuhuta,
peru kameyu xepɨkakwa'ani, tatsiu, haitsɨ meta tsimuaka, mɨkɨtɨtɨ mepɨte'iyawa, peru wakarutsa pɨka'anutahuhuta. Mɨkɨ tewaxi yeutari pepɨtiwamaiwe'erieka memɨka'itiyakɨ.
»Metatsiere tuixu pɨka'itiya, tsepanetɨ karutsaya manutahuhuta, peru pɨkati'iyawa. Waiyarieya xepɨkakwa'ani meta mɨkime xepɨkakumaɨwani.
»Yunaime hapa memɨteye'uwa xepɨtewakwa'ani kemɨ'ane yuwekiɨ memexeiya meta yukarara,
peru xepɨkawakwa'ani kemɨ'ane yuwekiɨ memɨkahexeiya meta yukarara, mɨkɨ matsi meka'itiyakame xepɨwarayeitɨaka.
»Kaniyɨwemɨkɨ xemɨwakwaka tsepa kememɨte'anene memɨte'awɨwawe perutsɨ memɨ'itiyatɨka,
peru kwixɨ xeikɨa xepɨkakwa'ani, werika 'amɨnena 'umete naime mɨtimura, maraika,
meta 'aru hepaɨ 'amɨnena, meta kwixi hepaɨ mɨ'ane,
meta yaxeikɨa yunaime memɨte'awɨwawe kwatsari yutsata,
meta 'aru 'amɨnena, meta kwixɨ meuyɨwi, meta hukurixi,
meta nɨpe, kwaxu, patu,
patu hepaɨ mɨ'ane 'amanuyepa, maraika, meta kwatsa haramari hapa mɨyeyeika hepaɨ mɨ'ane,
kwaxu hepaɨ mɨ'ane, meta yunaitɨ kwaxuri wahepaɨ memɨteyuxexeiya, tsurakai meta 'atsixi.
»'Utsikari yunaitɨ memawɨwawe memɨka'itiya xepɨwarayeitɨaka, 'ayumieme xepɨkawakwa'ani.
Peru kaniyɨweni xemɨwakwa'ani mematsunawawe xeikɨa yatsepa memɨte'awɨwawe peru memɨ'itiyatɨka.

»Tixaɨtɨ timɨkime xetekaxeiyame xepɨkatekwa'ani. Mɨkɨ pɨyɨweni 'ateewa kiekame xemɨminikɨ 'akiekaritsie memɨtitei, mɨkɨ pɨyɨwe mitikwani, yatɨni yeikame pemutuirieni. Peru xeme teɨteri xemɨpatsie xekanihɨkɨtɨni Yawé Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme. »Tsipu nunutsi xepɨka'etsani maamaya retsieyakɨ.
'Imikieri tamamatatsie mieme xeime kemɨtiyetuiwa
»Xexuime wiyaritsie, xekatehatɨtɨmaiyatɨ, ketipaɨmeme xemɨtekaxeiya kwiepa yu'etsarita, tamamatatsie mieme xeime.

Yawé xekakaɨyari hɨxie xekanikwaikuni mɨkɨ tamamatatsie mieme xeime xemɨteyetua, tɨriku, winu, hatseiti, meta xemɨwayetua tewatsiekate mexɨakate, mɨkɨ hakewa meyuhayewa mana xekateneyurikuni. Mɨpaɨ xeteyurietɨ xepimakaxeni yuheyemekɨ Yawé yukakaɨyari.
Peru xɨka Yawé xekakaɨyari waɨkawa 'aixɨa reyurieka xehetsiemieme, meta mɨkɨ hakewa meyuhayewaxɨ 'ahetewani, xɨka xekayɨwaweni xemenutɨnikɨ xemɨteyetuanikɨ manapaitɨ.
'Ana pɨyɨweni mɨkɨ mɨtiutuani mɨkɨ tuminiyari 'a'ɨtɨ mana kenuani Yawé xekakaɨyari hakewa mexatatsie.

Mɨkɨ tuminiyarikɨ xemɨte'utinaneni kaniyɨweni ketita xemɨteheuyehɨaka tita mɨtixenakeni matsi: wakaxi, muxa, winu yatɨni winu matsina, mana Yawé Kakaɨyari hɨxie, 'ekɨ meta 'atɨɨriyama xekatenikwaikuni xekaniyutitemawiekuni.
Peru rewitsixi keniwara'eriwatɨ 'akiekaritsie memɨtitei. Kena'eriwani mɨkɨ 'ahepaɨ mepɨkayetuiriyarie yukwie memexeiyanikɨ.
»Haika wiyari 'anuyeyeikakaku xepikuxexeɨriwani ('imikieri tamamatatsie mieme xeime) yukiekaritsie pɨta xepiyetuani, mɨkɨ wiyaritsie xemɨte'ukaxei hetsie timieme.

Mɨpaɨ mɨkɨ mepɨkayehakakwitɨweni rewitsixi yukwieri memɨkahexeiya, 'ateewa kiekatari, nutuite meta wiuraxi 'akiekaritsie memɨtitei, mɨkɨ mepɨtetikwani mepɨtihuxani. Hikɨ 'ana Yawé xekakaɨyari xe'uximayatsika 'aixɨa pɨyurieni pɨxeparewieni.
